# no-alt-text

- ID: `MD045`
- Category: Links and images
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: no
- Tags: `accessibility`, `images`

Markdown images have alt text, and HTML images have alt or aria-hidden="true".

## Why

Alt text describes an image for people who cannot see it, such as screen reader
users. In HTML, an empty alt or aria-hidden="true" marks an image that screen
readers skip.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

There is no automatic fix. Only the author can describe the image.

## Configure

Under `rules`, `no-alt-text: false` turns the rule off and `no-alt-text: error`
reports its findings as errors. The flag `--disable no-alt-text` turns it off
for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-alt-text -->
```
